name: rope
about: Thin string cylinder between two points
code:
def rope(name, p0, p1, color='#e8e0c8', r=0.04):
    a, b = Vector(p0), Vector(p1)
    d = b - a
    L = d.length
    th = math.degrees(math.acos(max(-1, min(1, d.z / L))))
    ph = math.degrees(math.atan2(d.y, d.x))
    m = (a + b) / 2
    return cyl(name, r, L, (m.x, m.y, m.z), mat('rope_' + color, hexc(color), 0.7), 8, rot=(0, th, ph))
